claims.claim: Recursive offers AI-powered support agents that answer customer questions using a business's existing documentation, available via chat and programmatically to other AI agents.

excerpts.excerpt: We turn your existing docs into a tool that answers customer questions 24/7 - from humans in a chat window and from other AI agents programmatically.

claims.claim: The product is designed to avoid hallucination by responding 'I don't know' rather than fabricating answers.

excerpts.excerpt: It says 'I don't know' instead of making things up.

claims.claim: Recursive targets small businesses as its customer base.

excerpts.excerpt: AI-powered support agents for small businesses.

claims.caveat: Suggests limited or no live customer base yet.
claims.claim: Recursive is not yet generally available; it is rolling out access gradually via an early access signup.

excerpts.excerpt: We're rolling out access gradually - sign up for early access and we'll reach out as spots open up.

claims.claim: Plans start at $49/month with no setup fee.

excerpts.excerpt: Plans start at $49/mo, no setup fee.

claims.caveat: Very low engagement; not strong evidence of market interest.
claims.claim: The company's Show HN launch received minimal community engagement (1 point, 2 comments).
